feature_definitions.is_temp: Binary (1: executed from /tmp, /var/tmp, or /dev/shm; 0: standard filesystem)
feature_definitions.arg_len: Integer (command line string length in characters, range: 10 - 500)
feature_definitions.entropy: Float (Shannon entropy of command arguments H(s), range: 1.50 - 6.20)
feature_definitions.is_root: Binary (1: process running with UID == 0 superuser privileges; 0: unprivileged user)
feature_definitions.web_parent: Binary (1: parent process is web server daemon like nginx, apache2, gunicorn; 0: normal parent)
feature_definitions.is_parent_dead: Binary (1: parent process has died or terminated, creating orphaned process; 0: alive)
feature_definitions.memfd: Binary (1: anonymous in-memory fileless RAM execution via memfd_create; 0: normal disk ELF)
feature_definitions.ld_preload: Binary (1: dynamic linker hook injection or /dev/tcp shell socket redirection; 0: none)

0_SAFE.description: Standard developer CLI, system utilities, background daemons

1_SUSPICIOUS.description: Temp script execution, parameter enumeration, unverified orphans

2_MALICIOUS.description: Webshell spawners, crypto-miners (xmrig), base64 stage droppers

3_CRITICAL.description: Root fileless memory droppers, reverse TCP interactive shells
